name: Non-resettable counter relay
summary: A non-resettable counter records events without a normal user reset function.
description: A non-resettable counter records events without a normal user reset function. It is used where the total event history is part of the documented equipment indication.
readingNotes: Check the specified retention behaviour when the auxiliary supply is lost.

distinction: A totalising counter is different from a preset counter intended to be reset each operating cycle.
